meta.name: contract-risk
meta.description: Audit contract management codebases for clause extraction accuracy, obligation tracking completeness, risk scoring model quality, renewal management, SLA monitoring, liability exposure, force majeure handling, and IP assignment detection. Covers NLP/regex pattern evaluation, obligation state machines, financial exposure modeling, and audit trail compliance for SOX/GDPR. Use when reviewing legal tech, CLM platforms, procurement systems, or any software that parses, scores, or manages contracts.
